news.title: Fall in focus: September photos of the month
Two minds, one breakthrough in heart disease research
news.summary_en: Mizzou’s Keith Cassidy and Zachary Berndsen collaborated to solve a mystery that had stumped scientists for decades.

news.title: Sixty years later, Missouri's bold investment in nuclear science continues to save and improve lives
news.summary_en: Mizzou is harnessing the power of MURR and NextGen MURR to fight cancer, strengthen U.S. supply chains, support national defense and drive breakthroughs in health, energy and technology.

news.title: CAFNR celebrates state-of-the-art facilities to benefit Missouri agriculture
news.summary_en: The four projects resulted from strong collaborations and investment in Missouri agriculture across agronomy, beef production, meat science and vinology.

news.title: Mizzou archaeology student digs into community’s local history
news.summary_en: A University of Missouri archaeology student’s search for a 160-year-old cornerstone became an opportunity to explore new technology and build skills for the future.

news.title: From storefronts to startups: Student entrepreneurs grow their businesses at Mizzou
news.summary_en: A new cohort of Tigers is turning ideas into businesses through hands-on experiences in the Mizzou Student Center — while returning entrepreneurs are taking their ventures to the next level.

news.title: Ravi Barabote received NACADA Advising Excellence Award
news.summary_en: Recognized for his dedication to students, Barabote helps undergraduates navigate their academic journeys and find opportunities that support their goals.

news.title: Mizzou prepared them for their dream careers, even when those dreams changed
news.summary_en: Missouri School of Journalism graduates Tom and Aly Trost Martin used their education to adapt, take risks and tell compelling stories.

news.title: At Mizzou, a scientist is rewriting the rules for how researchers study plant stress
news.summary_en: Rather than isolating individual factors one at a time, Ron Mittler studies how organisms respond to multiple stressors simultaneously, paving the way for better crops and potentially better medical treatments.

news.title: University of Missouri teams up with Google Public Sector to use AI to accelerate research and innovation
news.summary_en: Collaboration with Mizzou’s AERI Center will give researchers new tools, training and technical support to move ideas from exploration to real-world application.
